slides.headline: A mother knelt and prayed in front of this painting
Three children, one barrel
slides.text: Moscow, winter. Three young apprentices drag a huge barrel of water through the snow.

slides.headline: Frozen solid
slides.text: Water spills from the barrel and freezes into icicles. It is bitterly cold.

slides.headline: The adult pushes
slides.text: Behind the barrel, a grown man helps. The children still pull the weight.

slides.headline: Look at their faces
slides.text: Exhausted, frozen, but still going. They are children doing an adult's work.

slides.headline: The only one running happily
slides.text: A dog runs ahead of them. The only one in the picture having fun.

slides.headline: The boy in the middle
slides.text: Perov found him in Moscow, the son of a poor widow. Not long after posing, the boy died.

slides.headline: His mother came looking
slides.text: She wanted to buy the painting, the only image of her son. It had already been sold.

slides.headline: She knelt and prayed
slides.text: Perov took her to the gallery. She knelt in front of the canvas and prayed, as if before an icon.
